items.title: Introducing the Agent Experience (AX) Practitioner Playbook
items.summary: AI coding agents now pick the SDK, the version, and the pattern for your developers. The AX Practitioner Playbook is our method for finding out whether they get your technology right, and for fixing the sources they rely on when they don't.The post Introducing the Agent Experience (AX) Practitioner Playbook appeared first on Microsoft for Developers.
items.creator: Waldek Mastykarz
